intro: Can’t find your question? Feel free to send me a message.

vragen.vraag: Where does the name Thorax come from?
vragen.antwoord: Thorax is a blend of my own name, **Thor**, and the DJ name of my father, **Fax**. It stands not only for my own musical identity, but also for my father’s influence on my career.

vragen.vraag: What kind of music do you play?
vragen.antwoord: A Thorax set is full of variety: from timeless classics to modern beats, from sing-alongs to pure rave energy. There’s something for every generation and every mood.

vragen.vraag: How do I book you and what does it cost?
vragen.antwoord: Fill in the [booking form](#boeken) or get in touch directly. Because every party is different, I work with custom quotes. After your request you’ll receive a free, no-obligation quote as soon as possible.

vragen.vraag: What kind of parties can I book you for?
vragen.antwoord: From private parties to large public events and student or youth parties. Not sure if my style fits your event? Get in touch or check the [references](#referenties) to see where I’ve already played.

vragen.vraag: In which region can I book you?
vragen.antwoord: Mainly in **West Flanders**, around Roeselare–Kortrijk: Ingelmunster, Izegem, Lendelede, Roeselare, Ledegem, Dadizele and the surrounding area. I’ve also played in **East Flanders** (including Wetteren and Nazareth-De Pinte). Is your party further away? Just ask.

vragen.vraag: Do you bring your own equipment?
vragen.antwoord: If there’s no DJ controller at the venue, I bring my own — just mention it in the form. Need light & sound as well? Together with a rental company I’ll put together a [custom package](#licht-geluid).
Yes. Invoicing is possible (VAT BE1031.174.534) and I hold a valid DJ licence through Unisono.
